create_musicflamingo_config: create a MusicFlamingoConfig instance with audio and text sub-configs for multimodal audio-text modeling
initialize_audioflamingo_encoder_config: initialize an AudioFlamingo3EncoderConfig as the audio backbone for MusicFlamingo
initialize_qwen2_text_config: initialize a Qwen2Config as the text backbone for MusicFlamingo
build_musicflamingo_model: build a MusicFlamingoForConditionalGeneration model from a MusicFlamingoConfig configuration
access_model_configuration: access the model configuration from a loaded MusicFlamingoForConditionalGeneration instance
